_comment: The elemental version of the beast charm cooldown: charms the nearest elemental in a 3.5-unit radius for 1200 ticks plus 100 per level, otherwise working the same way (full companion, keeps its own level, reverts and turns hostile when it ends). Shorter duration and longer cooldown than the beast version since elementals hit harder. All values placeholder.
name: BindElemental
description: It keeps its own level, and turns on you when the charm ends.
